truth_contract.connected_definition: Only an authenticated account or API that has passed a real read-only connection test may be marked connected.
truth_contract.local_import_definition: A local CSV, XLSX, or JSON import is an evidence intake capability, not an external account connection.

providers.name: Web Scraper
providers.notes: Chrome/Firefox extension exports can be imported locally. Cloud API, scheduling and webhooks require a separately approved account and plan.

providers.name: 八爪鱼 / Octoparse
providers.notes: Desktop or cloud exports can be imported locally. API access is not connected and depends on the owner's account, plan and key.

providers.name: 妙手采集
providers.notes: Miaoshou collection/export files can be imported. This does not mean that Miaoshou ERP, a store, or its open platform is connected.

providers.name: 外贸工具采集
providers.notes: Publicly documented product-collection CSV exports can be imported. No verified public API connection is claimed.
